purpose: Runtime evidence for inactive-route handling in DeepSeek-V4-Flash target-only and fixed probabilistic DSpark K5 serving
hardware: 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell on direct PCIe root ports

correctness_probe.prompt_contract: Return one JSON object containing a=6*7 and b=3*a.

conclusion: The published image executes inactive padded MoE routes without assigning them to expert zero. Target-only and DSpark K5 serving completed full CUDA graph capture, sustained decode, and an arithmetic content check without runtime errors.
limitations: The published-image runtime gate covers TP2/DCP1 on physical GPUs 6 and 7 of the named host.
The runtime gate does not qualify DCP greater than one, TP4, TP8, native KV offload, or LMCache.
DSpark aggregate token throughput depends on the generated trajectory and draft acceptance; the value is a runtime sanity result, not a fixed model-speed constant.
The 131072-token validation profile does not qualify the 1048576-token serving profile.
